notes: v16 OFFLINE URDU ENGINE (tajurbaati / experimental): ab Dost ke paas Google ke baghair sun'ne ka apna engine hai — sherpa-onnx + Whisper, phone ke andar hi. (1) Settings mein naya switch: 'Sun'ne ka engine' — Google (default, azmaya hua) ya Offline Urdu pack. (2) Language Store mein 'Urdu Offline Pack' asal mein aa gaya hai: ~101 MB, 4 files, har file download ke foran baad SHA-256 checksum se verify hoti hai — kharab file install nahi hoti. Pack download karke Settings se offline engine chunein. (3) Offline engine sirf console/session ki baaton ke liye hai; 'Dost' naam wala wake abhi Google se hi chalta hai. (4) Ye pehli offline koshish hai — asal phone par is ki raftaar aur durustagi abhi test nahi hui, is liye switch par 'tajurbaati' saaf likha hai aur Google default rehta hai. Baaki sab v15 jaisa hai: modes (Normal/Driving/Expert), Admin ki awaaz pehchan, mic handover, Bara Dimagh.
